title: Unit Event — Hope Will Someday Go Beyond the Morning — Episode2 Repressed Feelings

meta.Event: Hope Will Someday Go Beyond the Morning
meta.Event Outline: While wondering what to do about the theme she was assigned during art class, Ena happens to come across Mafuyu sitting by herself on the side of a walkway. Ena decides to talk to her since it's raining and there's no sign of her moving...

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Incubation... Incubation...?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Is that sense of excitement and feeling of awe what you were truly after, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(What do I want to do for this theme...?
I need to figure that out.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Something being born...
Blooming... Growing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Wait, I want to grow as an artist...
What if I drew something that represented me trying to break out of my shell?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can try drawing myself hatching.)
se_event_wish_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, not bad...
I'll try going with this.
se_event_wish_2022_002

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, my rough sketch is just about done...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It's definitely not worse than what I drew the other day, and it goes with the theme...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can't pinpoint what it is... But it's like the person that I drew isn't actually me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I know I want to become an artist, and this is supposed to convey that and yet...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Is it the composition...?
Or maybe the perspective is messed up?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But the only thing that seems to stick out is “me”. The arms and legs don't look off-kilter or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do I just need to have more confidence in myself?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Knowing that my foundational skills are lacking and getting told that my drawings are bad... Am I starting to believe that there's no way I'll ever make it as an artist?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This isn't going to end up any better than before...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe I should pick a different subject...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Have you all started working? The new demo's ready, so I'd like for us to meet in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What...?! Is it already time?
But I still haven't drawn anything I feel good about yet...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess I should head over to SEKAI for now. A better idea might pop into my head while talking to the others.
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hi, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What's going on?
Did something happen again...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So... Mafuyu saw her Mom going through her computer.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! You set a password, right?! Don't tell me you didn't!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I did, but I told her what it was...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She said that I should if I had nothing to hide, and she never actually looked until now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But earlier today...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: When I got home, I saw her using my computer...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Why would she do that...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: She told me that she was looking something up... But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why use your computer for that when she could just use her phone, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What if she was looking for what you've been up to, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember what happened to your synth? This might be connected to that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: After she learned that you were doing something that she wasn't aware of, she decided to secretly play detective...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A-And that led her to use your computer behind your back?! What's wrong with her...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Um, Mafuyu...?
Has she said anything to you since then?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No. I made sure to keep Nightcord and any song files hidden, so I doubt she found anything about all of you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But there's a chance that she'll come snooping around again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hang on. What if you just changed your password...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If I did, she'd probably be suspicious.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why can't you just tell her to not look? She might be your mother, but she has no right to just rummage through your computer without your permission.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, that may be so...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I think she did it because she was worried about me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Being worried about you doesn't give her permission to do what she did.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, weren't you bothered by what happened? This is usually when you have to put your foot down.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I get that it's gonna be hard, but you really should say something if it's actually bothering you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Granted, that's a lot easier said than done...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Your song...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to hear your new demo...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hold on! We're not done discussing this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Okay, fine...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll play it now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Okay, I get that it's hard for her to speak up.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I get that. But...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (From where I'm standing, despite trying to suppress her feelings, Mafuyu looks visibly shaken by what happened.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (So... Why didn't she say anything?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Doing as her parents say without bothering to speak up about what's on her mind... Isn't that just going to make her suffer even more...?)
The next day
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've given it a lot of thought since then... But I'm still struggling to come up with a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Ideally, I want it to be something that involves me breaking out of my shell as an artist...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But this is getting me nowhere.
I guess I should go back to thinking about what I actually want to convey.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm? Over there...
Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...?
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I started feeling a little sick, so I decided to rest...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I think so...
I don't have a fever, and I felt fine during my cram school lecture.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No fever...
But you definitely feel sick, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm fine...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's just... My chest feels cold...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Rain...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh, this is the worst. The forecast didn't say anything about it raining today! You better head back home now too, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Okay...
After I rest for a bit longer...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, geez...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mafuyu, come with me!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're gonna get soaked!
How do you think I'm gonna feel if you end up catching a cold!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, we need to hurry!
